arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argued the Attorney General chose not to appeal within the thirty-day window.
the opposing side argued the Attorney General moved to intervene to exhaust all appeals for the state.
Justice Thomas asked for a standard to determine if the lower court abused its discretion.
the side that brought the case claimed the Attorney General was bound by the final judgment and missed the deadline.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines the limits of state participation in federal appeals. It clarifies when a state can challenge a final judgment. The outcome shapes procedural fairness in federal courts. It impacts how states defend their laws against federal rulings.
